items.detail: The homepage says Antler is active across 30 locations and also says 26 locations worldwide. Neither number was chosen.
The homepage says 2,000+ portfolio companies and does not name them. No company identity was recorded from that count.
The checked global pages do not state an investment amount or an equity term. Per-location terms were not collected.
The apply page says SR008 runs February 1 to April 16, 2027. The FAQ says the SR008 residency runs February 1 to April 18, 2027. Neither date was chosen.
https://speedrun.a16z.com/companies was fetched on 2026-11-09 and contained no company identities.
The selection FAQ describes what the team looks for and says review is rolling. It does not state an acceptance rate or an applicant count.
Batch 24 is announced as applications opening in January, with no year, day, or clock. That was not stored as a deadline. The six-month cohort pattern on the program page stays historical.
Only the first companies index page was opened. Later pages were not collected, so the company list is not complete.
The fetched portfolio page lists company tiles and does not give websites, investment amounts, or returns.
Company cards show participation and a cohort. They do not confirm the post-money SAFE, a round, an exit, or a return for each company. The alumni capital and market-cap sentences are not returns.
